9 Sequence diagrams
This chapter shows use cases for LIN communication and API usage. As the com-
munication is in real-time, it is not easy to show the real-time behavior in the UML
dynamic diagrams. It is advisable to read the corresponding descriptive text to each
UML diagram.
To show the behavior of the modules in the different use cases, there are local function
calls made to show what is done and when to get information. It is not mandatory to use
these local functions. They are here just to make the use cases more understandable.
Note that all parameters and return types are omitted to make the diagrams easier to
read and understand. If needed for clarification the parameter value or return value are
shown.
